description: 桌沿耳机挂钩，卡在桌板上，J 形挂耳
description_en: Under-desk headphone hook that clamps onto a desk edge, J-shaped hanger
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
desk_t = 25      # 桌板厚度 (mm)
clamp_d = 35     # 卡口深度 (mm)
arm_t = 6        # 臂厚 (mm)
width = 40       # 挂钩宽度 (mm)
hook_drop = 35   # 挂耳下垂长度 (mm)
hook_out = 25    # 挂耳前伸长度 (mm)

# === C 形夹 (倒扣在桌沿) ===
back = cq.Workplane("XY").box(arm_t, width, desk_t + clamp_d, centered=(True, True, False))
top = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=desk_t + clamp_d - arm_t).box(hook_out + arm_t, width, arm_t, centered=(True, True, False)).translate(((hook_out + arm_t)/2, 0, 0))
lip = cq.Workplane("XY").box(arm_t, width, arm_t, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((hook_out, 0, 0))
result = back.union(top).union(lip)

# === 挂耳 (前伸+下垂的 J 形) ===
hanger = cq.Workplane("XY").box(arm_t, width, hook_drop, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((hook_out, 0, 0))
result = result.union(hanger)

# === 圆角让打印更顺、不刮手 ===
result = result.edges("|Y").fillet(2)

show_object(result)
